 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
 requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
 to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
 are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM
 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
 wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
 Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
 the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
 required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  April 29, 2021

Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, social distancing requirements, and health
recommendations from LA County Public Health Department, this meeting was conducted
remotely. The Audit Committee members and staff utilized video conferencing in order to
participate in the meeting. The meeting was held in the Municipal Services Building (MSB) in
Room 105. Three individuals were present in the meeting room: Audit Committee Chair, Zareh
Amirian, Deputy City Manager, John Takhtalian, and Internal Audit Manager, Jessie Zhang.

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:00 p.m.

  Present:  Zareh Amirian, Ed Khashadourian, Alex Parajon

  Absent:  Thomas O’Shaughnessy, Vahik Satoorian

2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:

  A.  Report of Recording Secretary, re: Posting of Agenda

  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of April 29, 2021 was posted on Monday,
  April 26, 2021 on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall and posted on the City’s website.

3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A.  Minutes of the Audit Committee Meeting held on January 28, 2021

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian Second: Alex Parajon

  Vote as follows:

  Ayes: Ed Khashadourian, Alex Parajon, and Zareh Amirian

  Noes:

  Absent: Thomas O’Shaughnessy, Vahik Satoorian

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  None.

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  1
   A. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 03/31/2021 – Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit
  Manager

Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager, provided a report to the Audit Committee on the
Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on March 31, 2021. Ms. Natalie Minami-Valdivia
presented on the Express Risk Survey Fraud Prevention Checkup which featured a
comprehensive review of the fraud risk survey and included this risk assessment tool and
educational tool in identifying new or emerging fraud risks in City Hall. Ms. Minami-Valdivia and
Ms. Zhang answered questions from the Audit Committee members.

Mr. Sameel Salim, Senior Internal Auditor, made his presentation on the Dell Contract
Compliance Audit assessing the appropriate administration of the cooperative agreement
created between Dell and the City of Glendale. Mr. Salim and Mr. Jason Miller, Assistant Chief
Information Officer, answered questions from the Committee members.

Mr. Salim made his next presentation on the Payment Card Industry (PCI) Compliance Audit.
The PCI Compliance Audit is a reoccurring audit that is done three times a year and is essential
to determining the City’s ongoing compliance with PCI policies and procedures. Mr. Salim
answered all questions from the Committee members.

Ms. Jessie Zhang provided the regular update to the Audit Committee on reports, projects in
progress, continuous audits, quarterly follow-up status, outstanding issues, and advisory
services conducted by Internal Audit. Among the continuous audits, Ms. Zhang stated that two
user access controls tests have been completed. Additionally, Ms. Zhang informed the
Committee of routine team assignments by Internal Audit. Ms. Zhang answered questions from
the Committee members related to the quarterly updates.

7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

Committee Member Khashadourian asked for a status of Audit Committee Member Vahik
Satoorian, and his replacement. Chair Amirian echoed the inquiry and asked for a recruitment
update. Deputy City Manager, John Takhtalian provided an answer revealing that the City
Manager is aware of the outstanding issue on the Audit Committee’s fifth member and will be in
communication with the City Councilmember who had appointed him for a replacement in time
for the next scheduled Audit Committee Meeting. Chair Amirian accentuated the importance of
having the fifth Committee member in order to have the attendance of a full quorum and
continue to diligently participate in meetings and provide proper review, feedback, and guidance
on the City’s quarterly audits. Ms. Lucy Varpetian informed that the City Attorney’s Office is also
aware of the pending recruitment with regular discussions on this subject being done, and
attributed the delay in the process to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, stating that the
Councilperson has to meet with the prospective candidate and obtain the confidence that the
individual will adequately represent and take on the responsibilities of the Committee. Chair
Amirian took the opportunity to once again express thanks to staff on the manner in which all of
the reports are prepared with the prevalent use of best practices to deliver them. Chair Amirian
additionally thanked all pertinent City departments involved in their assistance with the audits.

  2
 8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  None.

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Ed Khashadourian  Second: Alex Parajon

  Adjournment at 3:47p.m.
